scope: Descriptive matching of all429 eligible low-score positives; no model/cutoff/rule changes, no new accuracy claim.
primary_control: Eligible hard_ordinary negative_bucket only; same outer fold and different whole game/position group.
additional: Separate nearest eligible legacy negatives and correctly awarded positives; all429 retained.
anchors: Prefer exact current ec_sacrifice, move_capture, move_check, offered_piece_moved, offered minor(any n/b), rook, queen booleans. If unavailable choose nearest samefold pool and flag fallback.
metric: Average over two windows of capped feature differences normalized by eligible pooled5th–95thpercentile range; missing-one cost1 missing-both0; average within six fixed feature families then equally across families. No scores/labels in metric or scales.
panel: Two closest distinct-group primary pairs per ECfalse/true x score-shortfall<=.025,(.025,.10],>.10; exact-anchor matches prioritized, tie key; strata order false then true,near middle far. Up to12 pairs. No cherrypicking after tactical inspection.
limits: No chess searches. Saved evidence only. Scores used to define miss/score strata and describe, not distance. Matching is diagnostic; reused controls and nonidentical boards not independent trials.
